title: Allowable pressure drop.
officialText:
The design pressure loss in any piping system under maximum probable flow conditions, from the
point of delivery to the inlet connection of the appliance, shall be such that the supply pressure at the appliance is greater than or equal
to the minimum pressure required by appliance.
